changed_surfaces.purpose: Record integration, latency, capacity, governance and runtime verification evidence without changing product code

commands.salient_output: Full backend test suite passed. Focused workflow tests passed 47 tests and release tests passed 51 tests.
vue-tsc and Vite production build passed.

commands.command: 20 authenticated real application create-and-submit runs with browser bell observation
commands.salient_output: Applications SQ-202608-024 through SQ-202608-043 created real workflow instances. All 40 lifecycle deliveries reached DELIVERED at attempt_count=1. Submit-response-to-bell P95 was approximately 945ms and maximum was 1027ms.

200 clients completed 12000/12000 authenticated requests over about 60 seconds with zero errors. Latency p50=109.63ms, p95=221.407ms, p99=343.717ms, max=420.491ms; the required p95 <= 200ms capacity gate failed.
Failed only on five pre-existing invalid .ai-control artifacts belonging to requirements 029, 032 and 033; no REQ-20260818-035 governance defect was reported.
Scope checker rejected the existing rokey branch name because its generic policy expects feature/REQ-*; the user explicitly required development on rokey.

local_checks.evidence: 20 real workflow submissions measured approximately 945ms P95 and 1027ms maximum against the 2000ms P95 objective.
limitations: Commit time is proxied by the submit response, which occurs immediately after transaction commit.

local_checks.evidence: All 40 real lifecycle deliveries completed DELIVERED on the first attempt; focused and full tests cover rollback suppression, isolated after-commit dispatch, atomic claim, retry, DEAD and stale-claim recovery.
limitations: Crash recovery remains test-driven because forcibly terminating the local process between consumer success and persistence would not provide deterministic timing.

local_checks.evidence: Authenticated browser showed real configuration-management notifications, updated the bell during sampling, displayed the business module filter and emitted no console errors; build and component contracts cover visible-only self-scheduling, shared in-flight requests and 2s/5s/15s backoff.
limitations: The in-app browser did not expose raw resource-timing entries, so exact hidden-tab and injected-failure request timestamps rely on lifecycle contract inspection plus browser regression evidence.

local_checks.evidence: 12000/12000 requests returned HTTP 200 with no pool exhaustion, but response-time P95 was 221.407ms against the required 200ms.
limitations: The authenticated endpoint includes the pre-existing security identity resolution path; its cost is not isolated from the notification query in this end-to-end load result.

diff_summary: The two-second user-visible latency objective passed with approximately 1.055 seconds of P95 headroom.
Capacity was stable and error-free at 200 clients, but API P95 exceeded the separate 200ms gate by 21.407ms.

invariants_checked.invariant: Performance targets are not relaxed to claim completion
invariants_checked.evidence: R7 remains failed at 221.407ms rather than being rounded below the 200ms threshold.

invariants_checked.invariant: Verification uses local non-production data and authenticated test identities
invariants_checked.evidence: All workflow and load samples used the isolated local runtime database and local admin identity.

invariants_checked.invariant: No product file changes are made during T3
invariants_checked.evidence: Only requirement control evidence is recorded in T3.

disturbances.event: The isolated runtime database contained V44 schema while Flyway history ended at V43, and a fresh database could not migrate past pre-existing V24 Flowable-table ordering.
disturbances.impact: Runtime verification used the isolated database with SPRING_FLYWAY_ENABLED=false; no migration file was modified.

disturbances.event: JWT-authenticated requests initially failed because AuthService.me() generated MinIO avatar presigned URLs while local MinIO credentials were invalid.
disturbances.impact: The backend was restarted with the existing local MinIO credentials; product security code remained untouched.

disturbances.event: Governance and scope checks include pre-existing repository state outside requirement 035.
disturbances.impact: Five unrelated invalid control artifacts and the explicitly requested rokey branch name prevent clean global-check exit codes.

assumptions_falsified: The existing authenticated unread-count endpoint does not meet the assumed p95 <= 200ms threshold under the confirmed 200-client load; observed p95 was 221.407ms.
unresolved_items: R7 response-time P95 remains 21.407ms above the 200ms must-requirement threshold.

The likely high-cost authentication identity and avatar-presigning path is under server/src/platform/security/**, which is explicitly read-only for REQ-20260818-035 and requires separate authorization before correction.
